# `DarkLibrary`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Progress and state of dark-frame (dark library) creation, from the imager or the guider.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, StartDark @0x3b9c00, StartBlockDark @0x3b9ee0, FormatPercent @0x3b8050, ResetDarkProgress @0x3b99c0, CreateDarkFunc @0x3bf770, CreateMasterDarkFrame @0x3be3f0, StopViewStage @0x3c1870, GetDarkNamePrefix @0x3b9400, GetDarksDir @0x3b8900, GetDarkThreshold @0x124910, HasFilter @0x125440, HasDark @0x3be090, InitialiseFunc @0x3c0000; guider DarksDialog @0xf8360 (64-bit builds) |

Sent while a master dark is captured and built. Imager producer: the dark-capture starters run a named DarkLibrary function, so the payload follows the function-state family. Function-state family (F): state is always written; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms when the timer is started or the state is terminal; code and error at fail even when the stored code is 0 (cancel omits them); route optional. A null or nameless detail sends nothing, and non-working notifications can be suppressed while the function cache still changes, so a receiver cannot rely on seeing every transition. The guider (TCP 4400) has its own dark-library producer with states start, building, complete and fail; the imager forwards guider event lines unchanged onto TCP 4700 (the auxiliary imager process suppresses that forwarding). Recipients: every retained socket of the emitting server (no verified/master filter). No fixed progress rate. No reply-before-event order is established: the RPC reply that starts the worker and the worker's events can arrive in either order. Working events are sent only when the whole-number percentage changes, so a client must not expect one event per frame. Stack processing can also start this workflow. Imager worker: on the main-camera process it moves the filter wheel to slot 0 (the wide-camera process has no light-blocking step and the mount is not moved), sets the stack exposure and sensor hot-pixel correction on (gain unchanged), captures five raw frames, rejects a frame whose mean exceeds the model's dark threshold (the first rejection repeats the wheel move once; a second, or any without a wheel, fails with 320), averages the accepted frames into MasterDark_<exposure>_<YYYYMMDD-hhmmss>.fit in the private dark-library directory (named by exposure and local time, not temperature), deletes older masters with the same exposure, and restores the previous filter slot (READ). Failure codes: 238 (exposure), 249 (memory), 300 (frame size), 320 (bright frame not cured by one filter retry), 207 (other), or the filter-move error (READ). A stop (stop_create_dark, or stop_func naming DarkLibrary) ends the run with cancel, which carries no code or error on the wire (internal code 253, not sent); INFERRED from the F rules. iscope_stop_view {stage: DarkLibrary} reaches only a dark run nested under View (READ). APK consumer expectation, not a firmware field: an app-state DTO declares has_offset for DarkLibrary; no producer of it is established.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver. The underlying worker captures frames and writes calibration files.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"DarkLibrary"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Imager function producer: idle, working, complete, fail, cancel. Guider dark-library producer (separate custom code): start, building, complete, fail. A receiver must accept both sets. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`, `start`, `building`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if non-empty stage string held | - | Only when a non-empty stage string is held. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if function producer: timer started (working) or terminal state | - | Elapsed milliseconds, independent of Timestamp. Working (or any state with a start and no end time, including complete) uses current monotonic minus start; other terminal states use end minus start. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail (function producer) | - | Function producer: present when state is fail, even if the stored code is 0. cancel omits it. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail (function producer) | - | Message for code; present with code. Lookup failure gives fail to operate. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | if optional; absent is a legitimate branch | - | Function-tree ancestry (for example View, Stack) built at send time. May be absent; not an address. [READ] |
| `percent` | number | if imager producer: every event (end states INFERRED); guider producer: build progress updates | - | Imager producer: on every event, a number from 0 to 100, completed exposure time over total exposure time, 0 before any progress (READ for working events; INFERRED for end states, from the shared formatter). The guider frame-construction path also writes it as a double. Range: >= 0, <= 100. [READ (imager formatter and working events); INFERRED (end states)] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, working - Imager build progress (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"DarkLibrary","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","lapse_ms":41250,"percent":60.0,"route":["View","DarkLibrary"]}
```

Event, guider-building - Guider producer build step (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"DarkLibrary","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"building","percent":33.3}
```

Event, fail - Function fail (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"DarkLibrary","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"fail","lapse_ms":1200,"percent":0.0,"code":238,"error":"exposure failed"}
```
